Bumper Bash.name: Bumper Bash
Bumper Bash.summary: A pinball simulator, along the same lines as Atari's Midnight Magic. But this one differs in that it uses the buttons on two paddle controllers to work the flippers, giving it that real pinball feel.

Title Match Pro Wrestling.name: Title Match Pro Wrestling
Title Match Pro Wrestling.summary: Title Match Pro Wrestling is a wrestling game released for the Atari 2600 in 1987. Players choose from a small roster of wrestlers and compete in one-on-one or tag team matches. The game uses simple joystick controls for movement, attacks, pins, and tagging partners. Matches are viewed from a fixed overhead perspective, with gameplay focused on timing and positioning within the ring.
